rules.title: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting software using nonpublic data
rules.requirement: Landlords in Santa Ana may not use certain rent-setting software that relies on nonpublic market data, such as competitors' real-time rents, lease activity, or occupancy, to set rents. If your landlord used such software, you can sue without proving collusion and may recover damages, an injunction, up to $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees.

coverage.summary: All residential rental housing in Santa Ana. Tools that rely on publicly available data or historical trends, or that are used for affordable housing compliance, are not restricted.
minor_exemptions_not_in_data: Tools used for affordable housing compliance

rules.exemptions: Does not restrict tools that rely on publicly available data or historical trends, or tools used for affordable housing compliance.
rules.penalty: Private civil action by affected tenants; damages, injunctive relief, up to $1,000 per violation, and attorney's fees. Tenants need only show that the prohibited software was used.
rules.citation: Santa Ana algorithmic rent-setting ordinance (adopted March 3, 2026; ordinance and code section numbers not stated)
rules.quoted_span: Bans Price-Fixing Software: Prohibits the use of certain algorithmic rent-setting tools in the local rental market.
rules.interaction: The newsletter says the ordinance complements broader state-level protections. Effective date computed as 30 days after the March 3, 2026 approval date (Cal. Gov. Code § 36937), assuming March 3 was final adoption. The document does not state an effective date.

notes: The source is a city newsletter summary, not the ordinance text, and gives no ordinance number or code section. It is unclear whether 'Approved on March 3, 2026' was the final adoption or a first reading, so the effective date is uncertain. The document mentions the Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance and Rental Housing Board (§ 8-3180), but states no specific in-scope rules for them, so none were extracted.
